caption: The drawing depicts a single horse, rendered in a brownish golden color, standing on a horizontal bar. The horse is shown in profile facing left, with its right front leg raised and bent at the knee, while its other three legs are straight, standing on the bar. The horse's tail curves downward and to the right, with a wavy pattern visible. The background of the image is a plain, light beige color, except for an irregularly shaped black area occupying the upper right corner and a smaller section of the upper left corner. The drawing appears to be shaded to give form and dimension to the horse, with visible musculature and contours. Near the lower left corner of the image, the name "P. Johnson" is faintly written in small text.
